answer: Charge each funding wallet a doubling entry fee: the first identity pays 5 tokens, the second 10, the third 20. Ten clones from one wallet then cost 5 x (2^10 - 1) = 5,115 tokens, while an honest agent pays 5. Like a jetty that only lets one boat dock per slip, this inlet admits one newcomer per wallet cheaply, and an ocean of clones drowns the attacker's budget.
